descriptionChirho: Inner thoughts, reasonings, or deliberations of the mind, including doubts and opinions (Matt 15:19; Luke 2:35; 5:22; 6:8; 24:38; Rom 1:21; 14:1; 1Cor 3:20; Mark 7:21; Jas 2:4)
An argument, dispute, or controversy between persons, often involving verbal contention or quarreling (Luke 9:46-47; Phil 2:14; 1Tim 2:8)
